sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Bunny Adventure is an endless run game, where you control a brave little bunny as it navigates through treacherous terrain, collecting stars and avoiding obstacles. The game's core mechanics are simple yet engaging, making it easy to pick up but challenging to master. You'll need to time your jumps perfectly, dodging rocks, spikes, and other hazards as you make your way through increasingly difficult levels.

The game's controls are intuitive and easy to use, with a simple click or tap to jump, and a slight delay to crouch. The bunny's movement speed and jump height are also adjustable, allowing you to customize your experience to suit your playing style. Whether you're a speed runner or a casual player, the game's controls are responsive and accurate, making it easy to navigate through the game's many challenges.

As you progress through the game, you'll encounter various power-ups and items that can help you overcome obstacles or enhance your bunny's abilities. These power-ups include speed boosts, shields, and even a temporary invincibility effect. You'll also encounter various obstacles, such as rocks, spikes, and enemies that will try to stop you from reaching the end of the level.
